problem.name: Give the role a name.

problem.builtinName.message: The role name “{name}” is taken by a built-in role. Choose another name.
problem.builtinName.note: name: the built-in role's name as the person typed it

problem.nameTaken: A role named “{name}” already exists. Choose another name.

problem.unknownPermission.note: permission: what was sent as a permission key

problem.ownerOnly.message: {permission} belongs to the Owner role only.
problem.ownerOnly.note: permission: a key like workspace:delete, never translated

problem.builtinEdit: {role} is a built-in role and can't be edited. Duplicate it to customize.
problem.builtinDelete: {role} is a built-in role and can't be deleted.

problem.assigned.message: “{role}” is assigned to {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}. Move {names} to another role first, then delete.
problem.assigned.note: names: the members' names joined as 'A, B and C'

problem.pendingInvite: “{role}” is used by a pending invitation. Revoke the invitation first, then delete.

impact.sensitive.note: permissions: the sensitive keys, joined with commas

impact.loses.note: who: counts of members, API keys and MCP agents (count.*) joined as 'A, B and C'; permissions: keys joined with commas

count.apiKeys: {count, plural, one {# API key} other {# API keys}}
count.agents: {count, plural, one {# MCP agent} other {# MCP agents}}
effect.stillEdit: Can still edit; must request approval to send

effect.noLonger.note: actions: the permissions' labels, starting lower-case, joined with commas

effect.twoFactorIdp: Two-factor becomes required; their IdP already enforces it
effect.keyAutomations: Automations that send through it will fail with 403

effect.keyCalls.message: Calls that need {permissions} will fail with 403

approvals.sendApprove: Holders can send and approve other members' sends; they can't approve their own
approvals.approve: Holders can approve other members' sends
approvals.send: Holders can send; the approval policy still applies to large or risky sends
approvals.request: Holders can request approval for sends because they can edit campaigns but can't send them
approvals.none: Holders can't send or request approval

audit.permissions.note: the audit log's summary of a new role

audit.renamed.note: a changed role's audit summary, before the permission keys added (+) and removed (−)
